verdict.rationale: Pulley documents e-signing directly on the platform for equity documents (SAFEs, stock agreements) and mentions 'board management' under its compliance product, plus a Signatory Status page to monitor signature outs — supporting the sign/archive/track loop for transaction documents. However, there is no explicit evidence of board consent or stockholder approval templates being drafted and specifically routed/archived against transactions (as opposed to option grants, SAFEs, and stock certificates). Missing for 10: dedicated board consent/stockholder approval templates, explicit board-resolution drafting workflow, and evidence tying signed approvals directly to the specific transaction record in an auditable chain.
